abstract: BACKGROUND: Ovarian tumors have generally been considered rare in the pediatric age group. We reported our experience dealing with pediatric ovarian tumors during an 8-year period. METHODS: Between January 1998 and December 2006, 37 girls with ovarian tumors were treated at the Department of Pediatric Surgery, Chang Gung Childrenfs Medical Center. Modes of clinical presentation, pathology diagnosis, methods of treatment and clinical outcome were retrospectively analyzed. RESULTS: Twenty-nine of the 37 patients were symptomatic with abdominal pain, abdominal distention or the presence of a palpable mass, reduction in appetite or nausea and vomiting and precocious puberty. Another 8 patients were diagnosed prenatally. Thirty patients had benign disease and 7 had malignant tumors. The malignant lesions included 5 germ cell tumors (2 yolk sac tumors, 2 immature teratomas, 1 dysgerminoma), and 2 sex cord stromal tumors. Operations performed were salpingo-oophorectomy (n = 22), oophorectomy (n = 8), cystectomy (n = 3), aspiration (n = 2) and biopsy only (n = 2). A laparoscopic approach was performed in 10 cases. Patients with stage II yolk sac tumors (n = 2) or grade III immature teratomas (n = 2) had elevated alpha-fetoprotein levels, and the patient with dysgerminoma was diagnosed as stage II b. All underwent salpingo-oophorectomy and received chemotherapy following their initial operation and remained free of disease at 8 months to 6 years of follow-up. CONCLUSIONS: In our studies, most ovarian tumors were benign. Epithelial cysts and teratomas were the most common benign lesions, and germ cell tumors were the most common malignancy. A laparoscopic approach was feasible in most cases. With accurate staging, complete resection, and chemotherapy for malignant tumors, patients are expected to have excellent survival rates.
abstract_ja: 背景：卵巣腫瘍は小児では一般的に稀と考えられてきた。我々は8年間にわたる小児卵巣腫瘍の治療経験を報告する。方法：1998年1月から2006年12月までに、長庚小児医療センターの小児外科で卵巣腫瘍の女児37例を治療した。臨床症状、病理診断、治療法、臨床転帰を後方視的に解析した。結果：37例中29例が腹痛、腹部膨満、触知可能な腫瘤、食欲低下、悪心・嘔吐、思春期早発などの症状を呈していた。さらに8例は出生前に診断された。30例は良性疾患、7例は悪性腫瘍であった。悪性病変は胚細胞腫瘍5例（卵黄嚢腫瘍2例、未熟奇形腫2例、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）1例）と性索間質性腫瘍2例であった。実施された手術は卵巣卵管摘出術（22例）、卵巣摘出術（8例）、嚢胞摘出術（3例）、穿刺吸引（2例）、生検のみ（2例）であった。腹腔鏡手術は10例で施行された。病期II卵黄嚢腫瘍（2例）または悪性度IIIの未熟奇形腫（2例）の患者はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇していた。ディスジャーミノーマの患者は病期IIbと診断された。悪性腫瘍の全例が初回手術後に卵巣卵管摘出術と化学療法を受け、8か月から6年のフォローアップ期間中無病生存を維持した。結論：ほとんどの卵巣腫瘍は良性であった。上皮性嚢胞と奇形腫は最も多い良性病変であり、胚細胞腫瘍は最も多い悪性腫瘍であった。ほとんどの症例で腹腔鏡手法が実施可能であった。正確な病期分類、完全切除、および悪性腫瘍に対する化学療法により、良好な生存率が期待される。
